name: 照尘寺（暂名）
status: draft; not implemented; positions to be fixed after the first whitebox
units: metres; +x east; +z south (north is -z); y up
origin: the centroid of Sifang Square, about 26.3195491N 99.8519663E, ground about 2105 m above sea level (SRTM estimate)
height_note: ground_m is an SRTM estimate (±5-10 m) and the square is nearly flat; eye_m is above the local ground. Do not treat either as survey data.
season_time: S01 autumn soft light (late afternoon, 16:00-17:30) as the base; winter clear and after-rain as separate variants

cameras.name: 东巷
cameras.purpose: sound before sight; the lane narrows, the gate opens, the stage eave peeks out
must_show: 戏台飞檐/屋脊的一角（不与门脊相切）
must_not: 戏台与东寨门门脊相切
cameras.notes: The rehearsal or wood-floor sound should already be audible here; the picture confirms it.

cameras.name: 广场南端
cameras.purpose: the whole square read at once: gate west, stage east, two locusts, paving
must_not: 寺门或戏台被树完全挡住
cameras.notes: The gate and the stage must share the frame; this is the composition the whole chapter is built on.

cameras.name: 寺门内（一帧）
cameras.purpose: the gate doorway frames the stage; the paving runs from inside the door to the stage
must_show: 戏台三层檐/魁星阁在上方
must_not: 把戏台强行居中（真实轴线可能偏）
cameras.notes: The exact standing spot where the doorway frames the stage has to be found on site; OSM suggests the axis is not perfectly east-west.

cameras.name: 戏台侧边
cameras.purpose: three storeys read from the side: shop, stage, Kuixing pavilion; the added rear stair
must_show: 一层铺面/背面室外楼梯
cameras.notes: The rear stair is a later addition; it should look like one.

cameras.name: 寺院一进（天井）
cameras.purpose: the first court: dim, quiet, the Guanyin tower as the end wall
cameras.notes: The square should still be audible here, low-passed; the first court is not a sealed room.

cameras.name: 广场回望（换场）
cameras.purpose: the same square after the loop: stalls packed up, lamps on, fewer people
cameras.notes: This is the 'the square goes on being used' beat; no forced time-skip animation.

framing_rules.amount: a corner of the stage eave
framing_rules.method: sound first, then the eave through the lane and gate

framing_rules.amount: the stage framed by the doorway
framing_rules.method: the visitor finds the spot; no forced camera
shop, stage, pavilion; the stair looks added

to_verify_after_whitebox: every camera stands on walkable ground
the stage is never cut by the frame in cam06
the gate-stage axis offset (official axis vs OSM 10-16 m south) is resolved or kept as a known deviation
the lane is narrow enough that the square is not visible from cam01
the first court is audible-but-muffled from cam05
